Simple & Compound Interest, Problems on.question: ১) If the ratio of principal and the simple interest of 5 year is 10:3, then the rate of interest is = ?
Simple & Compound Interest, Problems on.exp:
P/S.I.=10/3
Let Principal = 10
S.I. for 5 year = 3
S.I. for 1 year = 0.6
Rate = S.I./Principal×100
Rate = 0.6/10×100
=6%

Simple & Compound Interest, Problems on.question: ৩) A sum of Tk. 12,500 amounts to Tk. 15,500 in 4 year at the rate of simple interest. What is the rate of interest?

Rate=(100×3000)/(12500×4)%= 6%

Simple & Compound Interest, Problems on.question: ৭) How much time will it take for an amount of Tk. 450 to yield Tk. 81 as interest at 4.5% per annum of simple interest?
Simple & Compound Interest, Problems on.exp: Time = (100 x 81)/(450 x 4.5) year = 4 year.

Simple & Compound Interest, Problems on.question: ১৩) A sum of money amounts to Tk.6690 after 3 year and to Tk.10,035 after 6 year on compound interest.find the sum.
Simple & Compound Interest, Problems on.exp:
Let the sum be Tk.P.then
P(1+R/100)3=6690…(i) and
P(1+R/100)6=10035…(ii)
On dividing,we get (1+R/100)3=10025/6690=3/2.
Substituting this value in (i),we get:
P×(3/2)=6690 or
P=(6690× 2/3)=4460
Hence,the sum is Tk.4460.

Simple & Compound Interest, Problems on.question: ১৪) A sum of money lent at compound interest for 2 year at 20% per annum would fetch Tk.482 more, if the interest was payable half yearly than if it was payable annually. The sum is
Simple & Compound Interest, Problems on.exp:
Let sum=Tk.x
C.I. when compounded half yearly = [x(1+10/100)4−x]=4641/10000
C.I. when compounded annually =[x(20/100)2−x]=11/25
4641/10000x−11/25x=482
=> x=20000

Simple & Compound Interest, Problems on.question: ১৫) Find compound interest on Tk. 8000 at 15% per annum for 2 year 4 months, compounded annually
Simple & Compound Interest, Problems on.exp:
Time = 2 year 4 months = 2(4/12) year = 2(1/3) year.
Amount = Tk'. [8000 X (1+(15/100))2 X (1+((1/3)×15)/100)]
=Tk. [8000 ×(23/20) × (23/20) ×(21/20)]
= Tk. 11109.
:. C.I. = Tk. (11109 - 8000)
= Tk. 3109.

Simple & Compound Interest, Problems on.question: ১৬) In 10 year, A will be twice as old as B was 10 year ago. If A is now 9 year older than B, the present age of B is :
Simple & Compound Interest, Problems on.exp:
Let B's present age = x year. Then, A's present age = (x + 9) year.
(x + 9) + 10 = 2(x - 10)
=> x + 19 = 2x - 20
=> x =39.

Simple & Compound Interest, Problems on.question: ১৭) The sum of the present ages of a father and his son is 60 year. five year ago, father's age was four times the age of the son. so now the son's age will be:
Simple & Compound Interest, Problems on.exp:
Let the present ages of son and father be x and (60 -x) year respectively.
Then, (60 - x) - 5= 4(x - 5)
55 - x = 4x - 20
5x = 75  
=> x = 15

Simple & Compound Interest, Problems on.question: ১৮) Rajeev's age after 15 year will be 5 times his age 5 year back. What is the present age of rajeev?
Simple & Compound Interest, Problems on.exp:
Let Rajeev's present age be  x year.
Rajeev's age after 15 year = (x + 15) year.
Rajeev's age 5 year back = (x - 5) year
Then ATQ, 
x + 15 = 5 (x - 5)
x + 15 = 5x - 25
=> x = 10
Hence, Rajeev's present age = x = 10 year.

Simple & Compound Interest, Problems on.question: ১৯) A person's present age is two-fifth of the age of his mother. After 8 year, he will be one-half of the age of his mother. How old is the mother at present?
Simple & Compound Interest, Problems on.exp:
Let the mother's present age be x year.
Then, the person's present age = 2/5 x year.
(2x/5 + 8) = 1/2 (x + 8)
2(2x + 40) = 5(x + 8) 
=> x = 40.

Simple & Compound Interest, Problems on.question: ২১) The average age of a class is 15.8 year. The average age of the boys in the class is 16.4 year and that of the girls is 15.4 year. What is the ratio of boys to girls in the class?

Simple & Compound Interest, Problems on.question: ২২) Ten year ago A was half of B in age. If the ratio of their present ages is 3 : 4, what will be the total of their present ages
Simple & Compound Interest, Problems on.exp:
Let A's age 10 year ago = x year. 
Then, B's age 10 year ago = 2x year.
(x + 10) / (2x+ 10) = 3/4 
=> x = 5.
So, the total of their present ages 
=(x + 10 + 2x + 10) 
= (3x + 20) 
= 35 year.

Simple & Compound Interest, Problems on.question: ২৩) If Riya's age is four times the age of Siya and if Riya's age is 24 years, find the age difference between Riya and Siya?
Simple & Compound Interest, Problems on.exp:
Let Siya's age = x
Then Riya's age = 4x
But given Riya's age = 24
=> 4x = 24 
=> x = 6
Hence Siya's age = 6 years
=> The age difference = 24 - 6 = 18 years.

Simple & Compound Interest, Problems on.question: ২৪) A is two year older than B who is twice as old as C. If the total of the ages of A, B and C be 27, then how old is B?
Simple & Compound Interest, Problems on.exp:
Let C's age be x year. 
Then, B's age = 2x year. 
A's age = (2x + 2) year. 
(2x + 2) + 2x + x = 27 
5x = 25 
=> x = 5 
Hence, B's age = 2x = 10 year.

Simple & Compound Interest, Problems on.question: ২৫) 5 year ago Sushma was 5 times as old as her Son. 5 year hence her age will be 8 less than three times the corresponding age of her Son. Find their ages?
Simple & Compound Interest, Problems on.exp:
Let the age of sushma be x and 
the age of her son is y
Then five year before x-5=5(y-5) ...(1)
Five year hence x+5 = 3(y+5)-8 .....(2)
By soving (1) & (2), we get
5y - 15 = 3y + 7
y = 11 
=> x = 35
Therefore, the age of Sushma = 35 and her son = 11.

Simple & Compound Interest, Problems on.question: ২৬) The sum of the ages of 5 children born at the intervals of 3 year each is 50 year. What is the age of the youngest child?
Simple & Compound Interest, Problems on.exp:
Let the age of the youngest child is 'X' year.
Then the child elder than the yongest is 'X + 3' years
Since each have 3years difference upto 5 children
And given that
=> X + X+3 + X+6 + X+9 + X+12 = 50
=> 5X + 30 = 50
=> X = 4 years.

Simple & Compound Interest, Problems on.question: ২৭) The twice of sum of the ages of a father and his son is 8 times the age of the son. If the average age of the father and the son is 30 year, what is father's age?
Simple & Compound Interest, Problems on.exp:
Let father's age be x year and son's age be y year.
According to question,
2(x+y) = 8y _______(I)
and (x+y)/2 = 30
=> x+y = 60 year_______(II)
From equation (I) and (II)
8y = 120
y = 15 year,
Hence x = 45 year.

Simple & Compound Interest, Problems on.question: ২৮) The average age of husband, wife and their child 3 year ago was 24 year and that of wife and child 5 year ago was 25 year. The present age of the husband is:

Sum of ages of husband, wife and child= (24 × 3) + 9 = 81 year
Sum of ages of wife and child 
=> 25 × 2 + 10 = 50 + 10 = 60 year
Age of husband = 81 - 60 = 21 year

Simple & Compound Interest, Problems on.question: ২৯) The average age of 8 men is increased by 4 year when one of them whose age is 30 year is replaced by a new man. What is the age of new man?
Simple & Compound Interest, Problems on.exp:
Let the average of 8 men be x.
Age of new man be N.
Total age of 8 men = 8x
⇒ x + 4 = ((8x – 30) + N)/8
⇒ 8x + 32 = 8x – 30 + N
⇒ N = 32 + 30
⇒ N = 62

Simple & Compound Interest, Problems on.question: ৩০) When I was 24, my mother was twice my age. Now I am 44, how old is my mother?
Simple & Compound Interest, Problems on.exp:
From the given data,
when my age is 24, my mothers age is double of my age 
=> 48 years is my mothers age
=> Difference is 48 - 24 = 24 year.
When my age is 44
=> My mother is 44 + 24 = 68 year aged.
